Pass on the fake backend (CLI gate exit 0; evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). No hardware was attached and no hardware run is claimed. The package is model-authored (driver.lock.json authored_by kind model, model_id deepseek-v4.1-flash:1017, run_id wB2-127) and unreviewed (reviewed_by is null). The card's entry symbol Benning_MM12_class:Benning_MM12_Serial was confirmed at Benning_MM12_class.py:12. DEVIATION FROM THE CARD: the card's decision family-config and helper ScpiDriver were replaced by a direct Driver over the upstream class with a native.py factory. The upstream speaks fixed binary frames (55 55 00 00 AA and 55 55 01 00 AB, Benning_MM12_class.py:15-16), not text commands, so a family command table cannot reproduce the bytes and gate G7 would not find them in the clone; the wire syntax was not changed. The driver exposes the three upstream queries as nine scalar reads and one read-verb action. It is read-only: no writes, no actuator, no native stop and no Limit. The only gate warning is G8.SAFE014_NOT_APPLICABLE: SAFE-014 has no actuating limit to probe, and the gate message says every other CL3 test passed. device_kind is sensor because cap.sensing.read.v1 binds sensor, sensor.imu and sensor.force_torque, not instrument.dmm; the card's candidate class was used for the device's free-form function/value/unit display result, and the driver cannot switch the front-panel function or range. The fake is a recording stand-in in fake.py; the clone has no simulator and no upstream tests. Every canned reply is placeholder test data marked '# placeholder'; no number from it is a Fact, Limit or reference. native.py accepts port and optional clone_root, puts the clone root on PYTHONPATH, imports the upstream only when the hardware backend is used, and checks the status the upstream constructor stores. The acceptance gate ran the fake backend only; no hardware backend was opened. Upstream limitations not covered by this package: getMeasurement_baseUnits selects a range multiplier with a branch chain that does not cover every 0x00-0x31 function code (Benning_MM12_class.py:383-450), and the display multiplier table maps code 0 to None (lines 180-186, 510), so the upstream methods can fail for those display states; the driver reports the native result and does not re-decode or patch the frame. The three-byte measurement value is decoded with signed=False (lines 267-274) although the comment calls it signed (line 453), so a negative raw value is not represented by the upstream method. The two measurement methods each send the display frame once; the action calls each once, while separate @read getters call the upstream method separately, so a multi-field state read is not a single atomic snapshot. The clone also contains wrappers for other instruments (Fluke 8846A, Keysight 34465A, Rigol DP832A, DS18B20, BME280); the card's only entry symbol is the Benning MM12, so this package covers the MM12 only. All values are scalars; there is no array to leave uncovered. No catalogue_requests: no extension id was used.
